Question 2
?

A particle P moves along the x-axis where x>0. When the displacement of P from the origin O is x meters, its velocity is vm/s and its acceleration is x2+3m/s2. Given that the acceleration is directed toward O, which differential equation describes this motion?

a
ddx(12v2)=−x2+3
b
dvdx=x2+3
c
ddx(2v2)=−x2+3
d
ddx(12v2)=x2+3
e
dvdx=−x2+3
Submit
